reading_issues: Filename says 'Wawa SSE 2400 m' but the header gives Aspect SE and Elevation 2400 m; header aspect recorded (SE), filename's SSE kept in header_other. Slope, coordinates, air temperature, sky and wind are blank. The JPEG has EXIF orientation=6, so viewers display it rotated 90 degrees; the raw pixels are an upright chart, and all measurements used the raw pixels. Hardness bars and layer boundaries (22, 25, 30, 35, 45, 64, 65, 98 cm) measured from pixels. Glyphs: '◎◎' read as MFcr (two thin crusts at P hardness); '□(V)' read as FC with secondary SH at 64-65 cm (layer_grain for CT5 given as FC); '⟋(□)' read as DF with secondary FC. The surface-form row shows an asterisk-over-triangle glyph that is read as graupel-type PP (PPgp), stored as PP and flagged uncertain; no size. CT5 SC at 65 cm sits at the top of the 64-65 cm flagged layer.
